card.name: Negative words setting up inverted clauses
card.fires_on: Words right after a negation or comparison that begin an inverted or elliptical follow-on clause, such as "either", "Nor", "Neither should", and "what need then be said of". It also fires on auxiliaries after these words.

modes.label: Either after negation
modes.description: The word "either" closes a negative clause that echoes a previous negative.
modes.example: "No, I didn't<< either>>," Mr. Decenzo said.

modes.label: Nor/Neither inversion
modes.description: An auxiliary verb comes right after "Nor" or "Neither", with subject-verb order flipped.
modes.example: Nor<< do>> the letters of his associates show knowledge of

modes.label: Rhetorical how/what need
modes.description: A helper word or "of" in a rhetorical question that implies something is even less so.
modes.example: what need then be said<< of>> clouds gathering together?
